system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Before each skill runs, SciFlow equips it with a tailored SciMem view, providing the evidence, prior failures or lessons needed for that skill without exposing the full memory graph.
system_prompt_style.note: Runs on Claude Code; per-skill context composition described in prose only.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: `/ask` | Ask the wiki a question — retrieve and synthesize relevant pages
env_context_strategy.note: Compiled wiki context brief plus Claude Code tool navigation (Read, Bash); mechanism inferred.

context_compaction.note: Compaction is delegated to the Claude Code runtime; no config surface in the evidence.

observation_format.note: Claude Code tools return text; inferred.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: AutoSci runs on **Claude Code**, which speaks the **Anthropic API** protocol.
tool_call_format.note: Inferred from the Claude Code runtime.

tool_count.note: The Claude Code tool list is not in the evidence. The CI allowedTools list contains 7 tools.

edit_primitive.note: The Edit tool is provided by Claude Code; its definition is not in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency files or MCP config in the evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: `/refine` | Multi-round iterative improvement — repeatedly calls `/review`, parses feedback, applies fixes, and updates wiki until target score
loop_primitives.note: Default is the Claude Code react loop. /research runs a five-stage pipeline. SciDAG DAG execution is optional.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `/paper-plan` | Compile a paper outline from the idea graph — evidence map → narrative structure → section + figure + citation plan
planning_granularity.note: Also lifecycle-state idea and experiment pages.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: SciDAG is an optional augmentation for SciFlow.
multi_agent_topology.note: An orchestrator_workers multi-agent DAG is reachable through SciDAG. A cross-model reviewer LLM is also used.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: SciDAG is an optional augmentation for SciFlow.
delegation_mechanism.note: subagent_spawn is reachable via SciDAG operators and the Claude Code Agent tool.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: End-to-end research orchestrator — idea discovery → experiment design → execution → verdict → paper writing with human gates

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Each active entity carries an explicit lifecycle state.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: In implementation, each entity is stored as a.mdpage.
long_term_memory.note: Also includes an evolving skill library (/forge).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: making projects resumable from a specified stage.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Form checks are handled by deterministic linting, while content checks are handled by an independent reviewer agent.
self_verification.note: The linting is schema linting of memory writes, not code linting.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: repeatedly calls `/review`, parses feedback, applies fixes, and updates wiki until target score
retry_policy.note: Only applies when the /refine skill is invoked.

rollback.note: The SciEvolve metadata edits are described as reversible, but no code-level rollback mechanism is visible in the evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The workflow currently uses `--max-turns 100`, which fits one paper.
termination_condition.note: max-turns is configured in the CI workflow.

execution_isolation.note: Default is local Claude Code on the host. A remote GPU server over ssh is available.

permission_model.note: The .claude/settings.local.json example was not included in the evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Each write is assigned PASS, WARN, or BLOCK; blocked artifacts are quarantined until resolved.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a memory-centric agentic system that automates the full research lifecycle

open_source.evidence_quote: [MIT](LICENSE) — use it, fork it, build on it.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: AutoSci runs on Claude Code, which supports any Anthropic-protocol-compatible provider — DeepSeek, Kimi, MiMo, GLM, and more.

first_release_date.note: No tag list in the evidence. Paper v1 is dated 2026-05-29.
